pattern.description: Glob such as src/**/*.py. Without a slash it matches names.
pattern.title: Pattern

path.description: Directory to search in.
path.title: Path

function.name: bash
function.description: Run a shell command with bash. Each call runs in a fresh shell: a directory change made with cd persists to later calls, but exported variables and shell state do not. Stdout and stderr are merged, output is capped, and a non-zero exit is reported as an error.

timeout_s.description: Timeout in seconds, capped by the tool timeout.
timeout_s.title: Timeout S
